dev.description: Run the Deno server and the Vite dev server together

test.description: Run the server's tests and the web app's together

replay.description: Rebuild a test Session from a replay file through the running app (server/replay/)

shot.description: Screenshot the running app in a headless browser, with optional steps (web/scripts/shot.ts)

check.description: Lint everything (deno lint), then type-check the server and the web app
check.command: deno lint && cd server && deno check . && cd ../web && deno task typecheck
